records.text: Erika Kirk became a licensed New York real-estate agent on October 24, 2018 and was immediately employed by The Corcoran Group
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Then comes October 24th, and Erika (Erika Kirk) somehow becomes a licensed real estate agent in New York and is immediately employed by Corcoran Real Estate Group.

verification.notes: A license record reproducing New York Department of State data lists Erika Frantzve as salesperson 10401322765, expiring October 24, 2020, with Corcoran Group as sponsoring employer. records.text: Owens said Epstein's emails stated that Lynn Forester de Rothschild established the Corcoran Group, under which Erika Kirk held a real-estate license, while Owens could find only two listings associated with Erika.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The consistent Rothschild connections in Erika (Erika Kirk)'s life, whether it's through the Corcoran Group, which we had already showed you, established according to Jeffrey Epstein's emails by Lynn Forester de Rothschild. ... which is where Erika gets her real estate license under. And yet, despite that, we only ever can find two listings that have ever gone up under Erika Frantzve.

verification.notes: Current real-estate profiles support that Erika Frantzve was associated with the Corcoran Group and show few or no publicly recorded listings. However, Corcorans own corporate history says Barbara Corcoran founded the company in 1973, directly contradicting the claim that Lynn Forester de Rothschild established it. Because the statement combines a false founding claim with a supported brokerage affiliation and an uncertain listing count, it is mixed.
